name: mushroom antipasto
instructions:
The mushroom antipasto (renamed from 'marcella mushrooms' 2026-11-15). Variant A is the marcella variation; future variants join as they come.

=== VARIANT A — THE MARCELLA VARIATION (PORCINI POWDER) ===

Marcella's mushroom braise — three ingredients and olive oil.

INGREDIENTS:
- MUSHROOMS
- PORCINI MUSHROOM POWDER
- PARSLEY
- OLIVE OIL

PROCEDURE: braise the mushrooms in olive oil with the porcini powder; parsley to finish.
notes:
=== SOURCE ===

Variant A is Marcella Hazan's (a pass). Recorded as the designated side for [[italian-tomato-sauce]]'s bolognese build.

=== THE BOLOGNESE SIDE ===

Born from the bolognese herb question: parsley and mushrooms are both CLASHING in the vegetarian bolognese (variant B), but a porcini powder/mushroom/parsley braise alongside it gets both flavors on the plate — neither needs integration into the sauce.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[italian-tomato-sauce]] (bolognese build): the main this sides.
- [[italian-tomato-sauce]] (gnocchi-sauce build) / [[marcella-lemon-celery]]: the other Marcella entries.
